license_required.quote: Permits to engage in the practice of public accountancy in this state shall be issued by the board

issuing_authority.value: Nebraska State Board of Public Accountancy
issuing_authority.quote: Board means the Nebraska State Board of Public Accountancy

name.value: Nebraska State Board of Public Accountancy
name.quote: Board means the Nebraska State Board of Public Accountancy

type.quote: It is the purpose of the Nebraska State Board of Public Accountancy to protect the welfare of the citizens of the state

degree_required.value: baccalaureate or higher degree (150 semester hours for permit; 120 semester hours to sit for exam on or after January 1, 2025)
degree_required.quote: has completed at least one hundred fifty semester hours or two hundred twenty-five quarter hours of postsecondary academic credit and has earned a baccalaureate or higher degree from a college or university accredited by a regional accrediting agency

accrediting_body.value: regional accrediting agency recognized by the United States Department of Education
accrediting_body.quote: a college or university accredited by a regional accrediting agency as recognized by the United States Department of Education or a similar agency as determined to be acceptable by the board

required.quote: Two years of accounting experience satisfactory to the board, in any state or foreign country, in employment as an accountant in a firm

duration.value: 2 years (public accounting firm) or 3 years (government/academia) or 2 years (Auditor of Public Accounts/Dept. of Revenue)
duration.quote: Two years of accounting experience satisfactory to the board...in employment as an accountant in a firm...or...three years of accounting experience satisfactory to the board...in employment as...an accountant in government or business

kind.value: accounting experience under supervision of active CPA
kind.quote: in employment as an accountant in a firm, proprietorship, partnership, corporation, limited liability company, or other business entity authorized in any state to engage in the practice of public accountancy under the supervision of an active certified public accountant

exams.name: Uniform Certified Public Accountants' Examination
exams.notes: Board may use the Uniform CPA Examination or Advisory Grading Service
exams.quote: The board may make such use of all or any part of the Uniform Certified Public Accountants' Examination or Advisory Grading Service, or either of them, as it deems appropriate

interval_years.quote: may be renewed biennially for a period of two years by certificate holders and registrants in good standing upon payment of a biennial renewal fee

renewal_fee_usd.quote: biennial renewal fee as established by the board not to exceed three hundred dollars

required.quote: the board, pursuant to rules and regulations adopted and promulgated by the board, may require permitholders to furnish evidence of participation in professional development in accounting, auditing, or related areas for fifteen days within the preceding three calendar years or...for ten days within the preceding two calendar years

period_years.quote: for ten days within the preceding two calendar years

topical_requirements.quote: participation in professional development in accounting, auditing, or related areas

available.quote: the board may, in its discretion, waive the examination described in section 1-114 and may issue a reciprocal certificate as a certified public accountant to any person who...is the holder of a certificate as a certified public accountant, then in full force and effect, issued under the laws of any state

requirements.value: Must hold a valid CPA certificate from another state (or foreign country equivalent), meet Nebraska residency/place of business requirement, and either pass the exam or have at least 4 years of experience within the past 10 years; exam and educational requirements may be waived.
requirements.quote: The board shall waive the examination described in section 1-114 and the educational requirements specified in section 1-116 and shall issue a reciprocal certificate...who, at the time of the application...has had, within the ten years immediately preceding application, at least four years of experience in the practice of public accountancy

exists.quote: It is the purpose of the Nebraska State Board of Public Accountancy to protect the welfare of the citizens of the state

regulatory_model.quote: Permits to engage in the practice of public accountancy in this state shall be issued by the board

credential_type.quote: Permits to engage in the practice of public accountancy in this state shall be issued by the board

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall assume or use the title or designation certified public accountant or the abbreviation C.P.A....unless such person...holds a permit issued under subdivision (1)(a) of section 1-136 which is not revoked or suspended

title_protection.quote: No person shall assume or use the title or designation certified public accountant or the abbreviation C.P.A. or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that such person is a certified public accountant unless such person...has been issued a certificate as a certified public accountant...and holds a permit

scope_protection.quote: No person shall sign or affix his or her name...with any wording indicating that he or she is an accountant or auditor...to any accounting or financial statement or to any opinion on, report on, or certificate to any accounting or financial statement unless he or she holds a permit issued under subdivision (1)(a) of section 1-136

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate, practice privilege, registration, or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate as a certified public accountant or the practice privilege or temporary practice privilege, registration, or a permit under the Public Accountancy Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence in the practice of public accountancy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence in the practice of public accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the provisions of sections 1-151 to 1-161 (unlawful use of titles/terms)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any of the provisions of sections 1-151 to 1-161

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a board-adopted rule of professional conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of a rule of professional conduct adopted and promulgated by the board under the authority granted by the act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony under the laws of any state or the United States
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony under the laws of any state or of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any crime involving dishonesty or fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any crime, an element of which is dishonesty or fraud, under the laws of any state or of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew authority to practice as a CPA or public accountant in any other state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew authority to practice as a certified public accountant or a public accountant in any other state, for any cause other than failure to pay a registration fee in such other state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a certificate holder or registrant to obtain a permit within three years of expiration or certificate issuance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a certificate holder or registrant to obtain a permit issued under section 1-136, within either (a) three years from the expiration date of the permit last obtained or renewed

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Each office established or maintained in this state for the practice of public accountancy in this state...shall be registered annually under the Public Accountancy Act with the board.

education_semester_hours_required.quote: has completed at least one hundred fifty semester hours or two hundred twenty-five quarter hours of postsecondary academic credit and has earned a baccalaureate or higher degree

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: On or after January 1, 2025, any person making initial application to take the examination...is eligible to take the examination if he or she has completed at least one hundred twenty semester hours or one hundred eighty quarter hours of postsecondary academic credit

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: shall have all the practice privileges of a certified public accountant who holds a permit issued under subdivision (1)(a) of section 1-136, including the use of the title or designation certified public accountant or C.P.A., without the need to hold a certificate or a permit issued under subdivision (1)(a) of section 1-136, or to notify or register with the board or pay any fee

value: personal and subject-matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board
comply with the Public Accountancy Act and the rules and regulations adopted and promulgated under the act
cease offering or rendering professional services if authorization in principal place of business state is no longer valid
appointment of the state entity which issued the person's authorization as the person's agent upon whom process may be served
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: hereby simultaneously consent, as a condition of the exercise of the practice privilege: (a) To the personal and subject-matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board; (b) To comply with the Public Accountancy Act and the rules and regulations adopted and promulgated under the act; (c) That in the event the authorization to engage in the practice of public accountancy in the state of the person's principal place of business is no longer valid, the person will cease offering or rendering professional services in this state; and (d) To the appointment of the state entity which issued the person's authorization to engage in the practice of public accountancy as the person's agent upon whom process may be served

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: Any person who exercises the practice privilege afforded under this section and who, for any entity with its home office in this state, performs attestation services, may only do so through a firm or an affiliated entity which holds a permit issued under section 1-136.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: Such owners shall not hold, in the aggregate, directly or beneficially, more than forty-nine percent of such firm's equity capital or voting rights

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: firms may have owners who are not certified public accountants if the following conditions are met

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The board may adopt and promulgate rules and regulations to require a firm to enroll in and comply with all requirements of a board-approved program of peer review

inactive_license_status_available.quote: Any certificate holder or registrant who has not lost his or her right to issuance or renewal of a permit and who is not actively engaged in the practice of public accountancy in this state may file a written application with the board to be classified as inactive.

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: Each office shall be under the supervision of a manager who holds a permit issued under section 1-136 which is in full force and effect.

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda made by a certified public accountant incident to or in the course of professional service to clients by such accountant...shall be and remain the property of such accountant in the absence of an express agreement between such accountant and the client to the contrary.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: Nothing in the Public Accountancy Act...shall be construed to prohibit any person who does not hold a permit issued under subdivision (1)(a) of section 1-136 from preparing, compiling, or signing financial statements if an accompanying report, letter, or other statement does not express an opinion or other form of assurance as to the fairness, accuracy, or reliability of such statements.

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: Any person who has been granted the temporary practice privilege afforded under this section shall use only the title or designation under which he or she is generally known in his or her own country, followed by the name of his or her foreign country.

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by the Public Accountancy Act shall be sufficient to justify an injunction or a conviction without evidence of a general course of conduct.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: Any person who exercises the practice privilege afforded under this section and who, for any entity with its home office in this state, performs attestation services, may only do so through a firm or an affiliated entity which holds a permit issued under section 1-136.
